source.records: ≈110k records across Reddit / YouTube / Kickstarter / Discord / X / Instagram in one day
source.note: Operational experience only. Access permission stays in platform-catalog.json; a field note never approves a route.
source.coverage_boundary: Only channels this campaign exercised are recorded. The pre-existing CDP entries (amazon / bilibili / weibo) predate the campaign and carry no field note here; absence of a note is not evidence that the channel works or fails.
source.strategy_note: strategies/ records cross-platform operating strategy (rotation, lanes, quota sharing, channel pivots, cooldowns). Like a field note it is experience, not permission: it never authorizes a route, an identity rotation, or a challenge bypass.

verification_legend.verified: run end-to-end at scale in the field
verification_legend.partially_verified: channel works and extraction started, but the run did not finish
verification_legend.channel_verified: page renders over the channel, run not yet executed

source_types.vertical_forum: Long-tail community forums (GolfWRX, MyGolfSpy, …) behind Cloudflare, reached as authorized visible pages over CDP. Not a catalog platform: this note records a channel, not a bulk approval.

notes.restriction: Deep window backfill is rate limited: 422 'slow down', 429 with X-RateLimit-Reset, occasional 403
notes.symptom: Requests start failing mid-window and an exhausted run looks like a data gap
notes.detector: HTTP status plus X-RateLimit-Reset header
notes.solution: Classified backoff: 429/403 wait for the reset header, 422 retries with exponential wait, budget-bound then stop the window honestly and record it

verification.evidence: ≈3.9k windows / 100k records in one day

notes.restriction: Small communities return genuinely empty historical windows
notes.symptom: An empty window is indistinguishable from a broken script unless one window is checked by hand
notes.detector: Zero rows for a window that another channel says should exist
notes.solution: Verify one window interactively before burning a long plan; record empty windows as gaps, never as zero prevalence

verification.evidence: r/GolfEquipment 2021–23 backfill

notes.restriction: yt-dlp default clients are blocked by PO-token detection ('The page needs to be reloaded')
notes.symptom: Every video fails while the browser can still play it
notes.detector: yt-dlp stderr 'page needs to be reloaded'
notes.solution: Stay on tier 1: call innertube search/next/continuation directly, login-free, instead of dropping to a browser

verification.evidence: ≈3.8k comments across five query waves

notes.restriction: Comment payloads moved to commentEntityPayload (2024+); continuation tokens only appear in next/continuation responses
notes.symptom: Old parsers return zero comments on a page that clearly has them
notes.detector: Response keys contain commentEntityPayload instead of the legacy commentRenderer
notes.solution: Parse both shapes and extract the continuation token from the same response that carried the comments

verification.evidence: five waves, 2024+ shape

notes.restriction: Comment timestamps are relative ('10 months ago')
notes.symptom: Time-window analyses silently accept approximate dates as exact
notes.detector: No absolute datetime in the payload
notes.solution: Convert to an approximate UTC date and always set date_precision=approximate

verification.evidence: en/zh/ko/ja relative strings in the field corpus

notes.restriction: Direct fetches of comment pages return HTTP 403 behind Cloudflare; the page renders fully in a real browser
notes.symptom: urllib/requests get 403 while the same URL works by hand
notes.detector: 403 on script fetch, challenge interstitial in the browser
notes.solution: Poll passively until the interstitial clears; if it demands interaction, stop and let the human finish it, then rerun

verification.evidence: 4 campaigns / ≈2k comments

notes.restriction: The comment list renders ~25 of 58 comments until 'load more' is clicked repeatedly
notes.symptom: One extraction returns a plausible but partial list
notes.detector: Footer label 'showing 25 of 58 comments'; row count grows after clicks
notes.solution: Bounded click loop: expand in small bursts, re-extract after each burst, stop when the row count stops growing or the button disappears, cap total clicks

verification.evidence: 25 → 58 comments per page

notes.restriction: Replies are nested in the comment cards and only distinguishable by the permalink
notes.symptom: Replies are counted as top-level comments
notes.detector: Comment permalink contains &reply=
notes.solution: Treat &reply= as is_reply and keep the parent relationship in the raw snapshot

verification.evidence: reply cards observed on four campaigns

notes.restriction: Discord's internal APIs are unusable from an automation context (storage sandboxed away; localStorage undefined)
notes.symptom: In-page API calls fail with ReferenceError while the UI works
notes.detector: playwright/CDP evaluate errors on localStorage or window.__stores
notes.solution: Collect from the DOM over a user-logged-in session; accept the slower path instead of fighting the sandbox

verification.evidence: 16 channels + forums / ≈4k messages

notes.restriction: Lazy history loading reacts only to real wheel events; scrollTop assignment produces no event stream
notes.symptom: The message list goes stale after a programmatic scroll and never loads older messages
notes.detector: Row count stops changing while the scroll position moved
notes.solution: Dispatch Input.dispatchMouseEvent mouseWheel (after a mouseMoved) instead of setting scrollTop

verification.evidence: history only loads on real wheel events

notes.restriction: Anti-automation drops the session after rapid channel hops and timeouts that tear input streams
notes.symptom: Login state disappears after 6–10 rapid channel jumps 5–15 s apart, then 30–40 min of metronome-steady scrolling
notes.detector: Session drops to the login page mid-run; no organic typing/movement in the event stream
notes.solution: Corrected protocol: 20–40 s between channel navigations, mouse move before scrolling, one page per run, ~30% budget headroom, persist every round, rotate platforms instead of dwelling

verification.evidence: two observed session drops and one corrected rerun

notes.restriction: Forum channels render thread cards that already carry title + author + body
notes.symptom: Opening every thread wastes hours and multiplies navigation risk
notes.detector: Card list under [role=button] with div[class*=messageContent]
notes.solution: Use the card list as the corpus; exclude the #channels sidebar (it also uses h3) when selecting card headers

verification.evidence: feature-requests / bug-reports forums

notes.restriction: Official invite links rot ('invite invalid'); the official community is sometimes a Facebook group, not Discord
notes.symptom: The documented invite URL lands on an invalid-invite page
notes.detector: Invite page shows 邀请无效 / 'invite invalid'
notes.solution: Grep your own corpus for discord.gg/ codes users posted, rank by frequency, verify the surrounding context before joining

verification.evidence: server discovery from Reddit mentions

notes.restriction: Infinite scroll on search pages stalls; no more results load without real input
notes.symptom: Search results stop after the first batch; a timeout aborts the cell
notes.detector: Result count flat across scroll attempts
notes.solution: Real wheel events (dom_cua style) keep it moving; sample with since:/until: quarterly windows back to product launch

verification.evidence: 165 mentions / 7 quarterly windows

notes.restriction: Reply threads cost one page load each and yield few replies
notes.symptom: Reply crawling dominates the cell budget for little corpus
notes.detector: ≈1.6 replies per post in the field run
notes.solution: Treat reply threads as a background task, not the main course; the paid official API route stays primary

verification.evidence: 165 mentions / 7 windows

notes.restriction: Comments lazy-load on scroll and the comment row is an unclassed DIV five levels above the time element
notes.symptom: Class selectors return nothing on a page that visibly has comments
notes.detector: Zero matches for comment classes while time elements exist
notes.solution: Climb the ancestor chain from time (handle | text | time); reels follow the same modal pattern

verification.evidence: first posts, comments + reels

notes.restriction: Caption/author selectors that work on a post page return empty on a reel
notes.symptom: Reels collect comments but no caption or author
notes.detector: Empty caption node on /reel/ URLs
notes.solution: Fall back to the og:description meta tag ('<handle> on Instagram: <caption>') and strip the trailing like-count fragment

verification.evidence: reel pages during the keyword queue

notes.restriction: Keyword grids are locale-dependent: dozens of posts in Korean, a handful in English/Japanese for the same query
notes.symptom: A queue built per English term starves while the Korean term has a backlog
notes.detector: Per-term queue depth differs by an order of magnitude across locales
notes.solution: Queue per (term × locale); do not assume paraphrase parity, and switch to hashtag/tag URLs when a keyword grid is thin

verification.evidence: ko 90 queued vs en/ja ≈3 per term

notes.restriction: TikTok has no approved public content API route for this study; a user session is required
notes.symptom: Unauthenticated page loads redirect to login
notes.detector: Login marker present / redirect to /login
notes.solution: The user logs in by hand; collection is pending, so no connector is claimed and the method stays documented only

verification.evidence: login state verified, collection not started

notes.restriction: Vertical community forums (GolfWRX, MyGolfSpy) reject script fetches with 403 behind Cloudflare and render fine in a real browser
notes.symptom: urllib 403 while the forum is readable by hand
notes.detector: 403 Forbidden on script fetch; Cloudflare interstitial in browser
notes.solution: Authorized visible pages over CDP; extract article/thread lists from the rendered DOM. Channel verified, not yet run at scale

verification.evidence: forum listing + thread pages rendered over CDP

notes.restriction: Tab bindings rot: a tabs.find() on URL patterns breaks after redirects or reloads
notes.symptom: A collector silently produces zero rows on the wrong tab
notes.detector: URL mismatch after navigation; zero extracted rows
notes.solution: Re-list tabs and re-bind by stable tab id; keep navigate→verify→collect in one cell so a wrong page cannot silently produce zero rows

verification.evidence: multiple collect cells after reconnects

notes.restriction: A thrown grab script looks like an empty page
notes.symptom: Selector returns zero and the run records an empty result instead of an error
notes.detector: Zero matches on a page that visibly has content
notes.solution: Dump one card's raw HTML and isolate the script error before concluding the page is empty

verification.evidence: X and Instagram extractor failures during the campaign

notes.restriction: Throughput is bound by page-render waits, not by per-site rate
notes.symptom: One tab at a time leaves the browser idle most of the run
notes.detector: Cell time dominated by navigation/render, not extraction
notes.solution: Overlap waits: no-login archives run as background processes while two logged-in tabs on different sites render in parallel and persist per cell; per-site cadence stays flat

verification.evidence: one cell = 2 IG posts + 2 GolfWRX threads in 55 s

notes.restriction: Two collectors sharing one state file double the request rate and corrupt resume state
notes.symptom: A restarted collector starves while an old process is still alive; state counts jump
notes.detector: ps shows duplicate processes; log gaps and 429 spikes
notes.solution: One writer per state file: verify with ps and kill the old process before restarting; take an exclusive pid lock on the state path

verification.evidence: golf-main duplicate-process incident

notes.restriction: X live search gives no native time-bucketed history pull, so a single query cannot build a time-series corpus.
notes.symptom: One live search only reaches the newest few screens; older mentions never arrive before the scroll stalls.
notes.detector: Compare collected tweet timestamps against the intended start date; a single query never crosses weeks of history.
notes.solution: Drive the logged-in search page per half-year window using since:/until: operators, scroll-collect each window with the dom_cua wheel, dedupe by status id across windows; ~25-30 mentions per half-year window for a niche brand term.

verification.evidence: 7 windows 2023->2026, 161 unique mentions, X session stayed alive the whole run

notes.restriction: PullPush.io now rate-limits programmatic agents to a paid scraping tier.
notes.symptom: API replies 200 with body {"error":"Rate limit exceeded...paid scraping service"} on the first burst of requests.
notes.detector: curl the search endpoint once; the error body names the paid tier explicitly.
notes.solution: Do not plan PullPush as an archive backup; keep a single arctic-shift client with backoff and accept its throttle windows instead of fanning out to a second archive provider.

verification.evidence: pullpush_keyword.py aborted after explicit commercial rate-limit body; curl reproduced it once

notes.restriction: Two archive clients from one IP (e.g. a stalled window puller plus a keyword puller) multiply 422 timeout storms for both.
notes.symptom: Both jobs log continuous '422 Timeout. Maybe slow down' backoffs; counters frozen for hours while each process is individually healthy.
notes.detector: ps shows more than one crawler against arctic-shift; state file mtimes stop advancing while logs keep backing off.
notes.solution: Enforce one writer per archive provider: kill duplicates before diagnosing server load, resume the survivor from its state file, and only then judge whether the provider itself is throttling.

verification.evidence: golf-main ran twice concurrently for 3h at zero throughput; after kill+single restart the channel recovered

notes.restriction: Some forum stacks (MyGolfSpy/Invision) render a blank body inside the in-app browser while sibling stacks (GolfWRX/vBulletin5) render fully.
notes.symptom: HTTP 200, no Cloudflare challenge, document.body.innerText length 0 and title empty after 15s.
notes.detector: Probe body innerText length; 0 with 200 status means the stack is unsupported here, not blocked.
notes.solution: Treat blank-render forums as unsupported on this channel and pivot to another forum in the same vertical instead of fighting the renderer.

verification.evidence: forums.mygolfspy.com loaded blank twice in IAB; GolfWRX same-day full render and 3k+ posts collected

notes.restriction: Corpora biased to English unless queries are deliberately issued in target locales.
notes.symptom: All collected videos and comments are English even when the study needs JP/KR user voices.
notes.detector: Route breakdown shows zero non-Latin text while the market under study is bilingual.
notes.solution: Issue the same scene/equipment queries in target languages (골프채 추천, ゴルフ ドライバー おすすめ); innertube search returns localized results and comments per query with no extra channel cost. Tag routes like yt-equip-kr / yt-equip-jp for locale-balanced counting.

verification.evidence: wave7 KR/JP queries returned localized videos with Korean/Japanese comments on first run

strategies.name: Platform rotation (one round per platform, then switch)
strategies.when: Several platforms are in scope and each one throttles or batches differently.
strategies.invariant: Per-site request cadence never rises. Total throughput comes from overlapping different sites, never from hammering one.
strategies.mechanism: Run one round per platform, then switch. Each site only sees its own tab's sequential requests, so its observed interval stays flat while another site's render wait is overlapped (field: Instagram ×1 ∥ GolfWRX ×2 per cell).

verification.evidence: ≈55 s per cell, per-site interval ~20 s after rotation

strategies.name: One tab per site (the frequency invariant)
strategies.when: Two lanes or two workers could touch the same host.
strategies.invariant: A site must never see two tabs' worth of requests. Two tabs on one site double its rate — that is risk-control pressure, not parallelism.
strategies.mechanism: Assign each lane a distinct site; the lane runner rejects duplicate site keys. Spend the scarce logged-in browser across different sites, not within one.

verification.evidence: dual-tab pipeline only ever bound to two different hosts

strategies.name: One writer per archive provider, hand quota to the higher-yield lane
strategies.when: Multiple collectors target the same archive API (Arctic Shift) or the same borrowed session.
strategies.invariant: One client per provider per IP. A duplicate client multiplies 422 storms and starves both, so neither throttle diagnosis is trustworthy.
strategies.mechanism: ps → kill duplicates → resume the survivor from its state file → then judge provider load. Pause the low-yield lane to hand the quota to the high-yield one (field: golf-main paused so equipment keywords got the whole archive quota).

verification.evidence: golf-main 3 h at zero throughput against a live second client; recovered after kill + single restart

strategies.name: Pivot channels, never identities
strategies.when: The primary archive answers with a commercial-rate-limit wall or a hard block.
strategies.invariant: No account, proxy, key or identity rotation: a blocked channel is recorded as a gap and the run switches to another authorized channel.
strategies.mechanism: PullPush commercial wall → stop planning it as a backup; keep a single arctic client with backoff, and move volume to a browser-visible forum channel in the same vertical (GolfWRX).

verification.evidence: PullPush paid-tier body reproduced once with curl; volume shifted to the browser channel

strategies.name: Windowed search (time buckets instead of deep pagination)
strategies.when: Live search has no time-bucketed history and infinite scroll stalls after a few screens.
strategies.invariant: No scroll past the stall and no request-rate ramp: history is rebuilt by time windows, deduped by post id across windows.
strategies.mechanism: Drive the logged-in search page with since:/until: half-year windows; collect each window with real wheel events; dedupe by status id and keep the window tag for traceability (field: 7 windows back to 2023, ~25–30 mentions each).

verification.evidence: 7 windows, 161 unique mentions, session alive for the whole run

strategies.name: Session health, cooldown, human re-login
strategies.when: A logged-in platform (Discord / X / Instagram) starts dropping sessions or showing anti-automation signatures.
strategies.invariant: A dropped session is re-authenticated by the human, never by the agent; the platform cools down before any retry, and other platforms keep working meanwhile.
strategies.mechanism: Detect the drop → put the platform in cooldown (default 30 min) → human re-login → re-verify the session → resume. Rotate to another platform while one cools down; never rapid re-auth.

verification.evidence: three Discord drops in one day; corrected cadence held afterwards

strategies.name: Batch auto-relay (no idle quota gap)
strategies.when: A quota-limited route runs in batches (keyword waves, window backfill).
strategies.invariant: The next batch starts when the current process exits; state files checkpoint every batch; goal counting stays nominal + deduped so a relay never inflates the target.
strategies.mechanism: Queue batches, chain them on process exit, keep one state file per route, and recompute the goal counter across files after each batch.

verification.evidence: equipment keyword batch 1 → batch 2 relay ran unattended

strategies.name: Multilingual query routes (avoid an English-biased corpus)
strategies.when: The study market is bilingual or non-English (JP / KR / CN).
strategies.invariant: Locale coverage is a sampling decision, recorded per route; it is never inferred from an English query's yield.
strategies.mechanism: Issue the same scene/equipment queries in each target language, tag routes per locale (yt-equip-kr / yt-equip-jp), and report yield per locale so a thin locale is visible as a gap.

verification.evidence: wave 7 KR/JP queries returned localized videos and comments

strategies.name: Blank-render triage (200 + empty body is not a challenge)
strategies.when: A forum loads HTTP 200 with an empty body inside the in-app browser.
strategies.invariant: 200 + empty innerText = unsupported stack; never 'fix' it with more automation or a different identity.
strategies.mechanism: Probe body innerText length and title; if both are empty after a render wait, mark the stack unsupported and pivot to another forum in the same vertical (GolfWRX vBulletin5 rendered; MyGolfSpy/Invision stayed blank).

verification.evidence: MyGolfSpy blank twice; GolfWRX 3k+ posts the same day

strategies.name: Cell budget headroom
strategies.when: Any scroll/click cell runs under a timeout.
strategies.invariant: A timeout must never tear an input event stream mid-dispatch — that signature reads as automation.
strategies.mechanism: Leave ~30% headroom on every cell budget, prefer collecting less, and persist after each round; a torn cell is a stop signal, not a retry signal.

verification.evidence: Discord drop signature decompiled from two incidents

strategies.name: Nominal vs deduped goal counting
strategies.when: Several files, routes or platforms contribute to one collection goal.
strategies.invariant: Acceptance uses the deduped count; nominal counts stay visible only as a running estimate.
strategies.mechanism: Recompute the counter across all output files after each batch: nominal per file, deduped total by record id, and per-route/locale breakdown so a thin route cannot hide behind a fat one.

verification.evidence: four-goal campaign board: nominal vs deduped gap ≈2–3%
